# SaveImage

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Images](BlitzBasic-Images)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SaveImage:Int32 image:Int32, bmpfile:String, frame:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `image` | Int32 | required | The image. |
| `bmpfile` | String | required |  |
| `frame` | Int32 | `0` | The frame to save. Defaults to 0. |

**Returns:** 1 if the file was written, otherwise 0. With [AsyncSaving](AsyncSaving) on, 1 means that the save was queued, see [SavesFailed](SavesFailed).

## Description

Writes one frame of an image into a picture file. The format comes from the end of the file name, as for [SaveBuffer](SaveBuffer): `.bmp`, `.png`, `.jpg`, `.webp`, `.jxl` and `.tga`, and any other name is a BMP. If the image has see-through pixels, PNG, WebP, JPEG XL, TGA and BMP files keep them (JPEG has no alpha). The optional `settings` choose how the file is made, see [Saving pictures](Saving-Pictures).

## Differences

* The original only writes BMP files. Here the ending of the name picks PNG, JPEG, WebP, JPEG XL, TGA or BMP, and the `settings` argument is new.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Local img = CreateImage(64, 64)
SetBuffer ImageBuffer(img)
Color 255, 255, 0
Oval 0, 0, 64, 64, 1
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
If SaveImage(img, "saved.png") Then Print "saved.png written" Else Print "could not save"
SaveImage img, "saved.webp", 0, "lossless=1"
WaitKey
```
